# St Thomas Heating & Cooling

> St Thomas Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving St. Thomas, Middlesex County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (548) 457-2400  |  Email: contact@stthomasheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://stthomasheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: St. Thomas, London, Strathroy, Dorchester, Komoka, Aylmer, Lucan
